name: Grave Chill
primary:
Grave cold: slows, freezes and withers.
A zone at the aim point with a 3-block radius for 6 s. Every second, on everyone inside except you:
• Damage 0.25 ❤ death
• Cold 30: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 3.75 s
